# Igor Kostyuchenok

> Technology executive, FinTech specialist, and
> thought leader writing about banking technology,
> artificial intelligence, enterprise architecture,
> and engineering leadership.

## About the Author

Igor Kostyuchenok writes about the intersection
of financial services, technology strategy,
artificial intelligence, and software engineering.

## Areas of Expertise

- Banking technology and digital transformation
- FinTech and digital banking infrastructure
- AI strategy and AI-assisted software engineering
- Enterprise architecture
- Platform engineering
- Technology leadership and CTO responsibilities
- Operational resilience and cybersecurity

## Blog Posts

### AI and Software Engineering

- [Your AI Strategy Can't Be a Vendor RFP](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/04-ai-strategy-not-an-rfp) — 2026-06-23: AI is a capability you build, not a product you procure. Banks that refuse to become technology companies will be commoditized.
- [AI Code Quality: The Junior Engineer Equilibrium](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/ai-code-quality-junior-engineer-equilibrium) — 2026-04-21: AI-generated code behaves like junior-engineer code: fast to produce, plausible in review, and expensive to maintain. What the evidence says about quality, trust and technical debt.
- [Future of Coding](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/future-of-coding) — 2026-03-01: Developers feel faster with AI, but controlled studies show otherwise. A look at the productivity paradox, review bottlenecks, quality risks and what engineering leaders should measure.

### Banking Technology and Strategy

- [The Challengers Became the Incumbents. The Incumbents Became Irrelevant.](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/12-challengers-became-incumbents) — 2026-08-21: Revolut made $2.3 billion in profit. Monzo is on its third year of profitability. The challenger bank narrative is over — because the challengers won. The banks that were supposed to be unassailable are now the ones losing customers.
- [Banks Have to Compete With AI Hyperscalers Now](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/banks-ai-hyperscalers) — 2026-06-22: OpenAI, Anthropic, FIS and Fiserv are turning AI into banking infrastructure. Banks that treat AI as a vendor feature risk becoming tenants on someone else's platform.
- [The White-Label Paradox](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/white-label-banking) — 2026-05-06: Why Banking Infrastructure Is Both the Opportunity and the Trap
- [Oman: Open Banking Outlook](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/oman-open-banking) — 2026-02-11: Oman's banking sector has shown consistent growth over the last decade, with total assets almost doubling from RO 25.8 billion in 2015 to a projected RO 47.8 billion by the end of 2025.
- [Incumbents’ Trap](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/incumbents-trap) — 2026-02-02: Despite the recent advancements of neobanks, incumbents are still the driving banking force of the financial world. Let’s take a look at some numbers — and to make it more “dramatic,” we’ll focus on the UK.
- [Only Ecosystems Will Survive](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/ecosystems-will-survive) — 2026-01-31: The world of banking is at the verge of big changes that most incumbents are desperately trying to ignore.

### Technology Leadership and Architecture

- [Every Bank Needs a Platform Team](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/11-platform-engineering) — 2026-07-16: A platform team is the nucleus of a modern bank technology org. It automates the toil, grows internal talent, and gives stream-aligned teams the autonomy to ship without waiting.
- [Enterprise Architecture Is Not a PowerPoint Exercise](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/10-enterprise-architecture) — 2026-07-11: Architecture created in an ivory tower is fiction. Real enterprise architecture is built with engineers, validated against production, and justified by business value.
- [Your CTO Is the Reason Your Bank Is Falling Behind](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/05-your-cto-is-falling-behind) — 2026-07-04: Most bank CTOs are too slow, too indecisive, and too far from engineering to lead through AI-driven change.
- [Modern Bank CTO](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/bank-cto) — 2026-06-21: Most bank CTOs haven't built anything in years. That's a problem.

### Security and Resilience

- [Revolut Keeps Getting Breached. The Fines Were Never the Problem.](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/14-revolut-breach-root-cause) — 2026-09-15: A fake email from a real government domain cost Revolut almost 700 customers their passports, selfies and transaction histories. The attackers are posting a victim a day and want 10,000 Bitcoin. Revolut's breach history is not bad luck — it is a pattern the company has paid fines to avoid fixing.

### Other Writing

- [Regulation as Code: When AI Learns to Read the Rulebook](https://kostyuchenok.com/blog/15-regulation-as-code) — 2026-09-23: A bank told Kyndryl that 60% of its total cost was spent on compliance—and doing it better than the competition doesn't confer a differential advantage. The answer is not more compliance officers. It is turning the regulation itself into software. AI is already doing it.
